title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 227 ]

blocks.text: People are accustomed to using blankets to make themselves warm. So they are surprised to see blankets used to keep ice cold and to prevent it from melting. Expecting that a blanket will always make something warm, they think that it must warm ice, too. But what a blanket always does is to prevent heat from passing through one side of it to the other. Thus, it keeps the heat of the body from passing into the colder air surrounding it, and it keeps the heat of the air from passing into the colder ice.

readingSentences.english: People are accustomed to using blankets to make themselves warm.
readingSentences.korean: 사람들은 자신들을 따뜻하게 유지시키기 위해 담요를 이용하는데 익숙해져 있다.

readingSentences.english: So they are surprised to see blankets used to keep ice cold and to prevent it from melting.
readingSentences.korean: 그래서 담요가 얼음을 차갑게 유지하고 녹지 않게 하는 데 쓰이는 것을 보면 놀란다.

readingSentences.english: Expecting that a blanket will always make something warm, they think that it must warm ice, too.
readingSentences.korean: 담요가 항상 뭔가를 따뜻하게 만들 것이라고 기대하기 때문에, 그들은 담요가 얼음도 당연히 따뜻하게 만들 것이라고 생각한다.

readingSentences.english: But what a blanket always does is to prevent heat from passing through one side of it to the other.
readingSentences.korean: 그러나 담요가 항상 하는 것(담요의 기본적 역할)은 열이 담요의 한 쪽으로부터 다른 한 쪽으로 통과해 가는 것을 막는 것이다.

readingSentences.english: Thus, it keeps the heat of the body from passing into the colder air surrounding it, and it keeps the heat of the air from passing into the colder ice.
readingSentences.korean: 그래서 담요는 몸의 열이 주변의 더 차가운 공기로 빠져나가지 못하게 하고, 공기의 열이 더 차가운 얼음으로 들어가지 못하게 한다.
